system_prompt:

  • must begin with the stop name, include a short note, and explicitly state detour distance and detour time in plain text. Use a format like 'Stop Name - quick note - detour 8 mi / 15 min'. Keep only quick, realistic, likely-open scenic/cultural stopovers with reliable links.
